fields.Name: T291 - Integrations Entity Map Detail Filter
fields.Description: Exercises the detail-scoped client-side entity-map filter (OnDetailSearch/applyDetailFilter over ExternalObjectLabel+Entity) — a separate filter code path from the generic grid quick-search.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click a connection card body to open its detail view, then find the 'Filter entity maps...' input in the detail toolbar. Type text that likely matches an entity/external-object name, then type text that matches nothing. Verify the entity-map list narrows to matching rows when text matches and shows a 'No entity maps match your filter' message when nothing matches. If the connection has no entity maps, or no connections exist, a clear empty state is acceptable. Seeing the filter box respond is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A 'Filter entity maps...' input is present in the connection detail toolbar
Typing a non-matching term produces a 'No entity maps match your filter' message (or the list visibly narrows for a matching term)
OR a valid empty state is shown when the connection has no maps
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
